title: AI on the Ballot
author: Ben Thompson
description: Data Centers were on the ballot, and they lost in a major way; what does it mean if American opposition to building is permanent?
summary: Listen to this post : Log in to listen From Bloomberg this morning at 2 a.m. Central: Democrats won control of both chambers of the US Congress in a midterm election landslide that amounted to a rejection of President Donald Trump following widespread voter discontent with the economy and the war in Iran.
takeaways: They just suddenly no longer had a job, and a huge number of cities across the Rust Belt no longer had a reason to exist.
Several news organizations projected that Democrats would win the House, while Decision Desk HQ projected they took the Senate.

My Milwaukee Brewers — excuse me, my World Champion Milwaukee Brewers — demanded my full attention, which also meant I saw a lot of campaign ads, and by far the most common topic, at least here in Wisconsin, was data centers.
